founders.name: Steven Henderson
founders.bio: Steven is a marine engineer by background and has managed a wide range of businesses and operations in the marine environment including cargo ships, a hospital ship, and one of the largest offshore facilities in the US Gulf of Mexico. He has a bachelors of science in Marine Engineering Systems from the US Merchant Marine Academy and an MBA from Harvard Business School. Steven served in the US Navy Reserve as a Strategic Sealift Officer.

founders.name: Mike Carter
founders.bio: Michael is a marine engineer and enterprise sales professional. He graduated from the US Merchant Marine Academy with a BS in Marine Engineering Systems and received an MBA from Rice. Michael brings expertise in marine engineering, ship operations, and significant business experience in energy and shipping. He is also proud to have served as an officer in the US Navy Reserve.

name: chrt
description: chrt is a logistics platform for time-critical shipping

founders.name: Kyle Reagan
founders.bio: Software engineer, Co-founder and CEO of chrt, building a platform for Time-Critical Logistics operated by AI agents. Previously, Kyle led Strategy at a Series C Time-Critical Logistics startup, scaling the company 4x and working closely with dozens of enterprise customers, like J&J and Boeing. Kyle studied Mechanical Engineering and Mathematics and builds web and mobile apps.

founders.name: Aaron Carver
founders.bio: Software developer, Co-Founder and CTO of chrt - a platform for Time-Critical Logistics operated by AI agents. Aaron is an expert in the web stack. He's worked at a YC company as a full stack developer and deployed many full-stack side projects. He's also trained from-scratch AI/ML models, deployed NLP microservices, and hosted LLMs in high-security environments for clients like the DoD. Aaron studied Chemical Engineering and Computational Science.
